long_biography.plain_text:
Marco Tronchetti Provera took operational leadership of Pirelli in 1992, after a restructuring programme returned the tyre group to stability. He had joined six years earlier through Camfin, following a period developing his family's maritime-transport activities and creating a financial holding.

His influence now runs through Marco Tronchetti Provera & C., which controls Camfin and other investment vehicles holding Pirelli shares indirectly. That chain represents his equity position; it is not ownership of Pirelli's entire business. After three decades as chief executive and a subsequent period as executive vice-chairman, he became executive chairman in 2026, retaining responsibility for strategy while the chief executive manages operations.
